name: 33760 · Clearwater, FL
findings: ZIP 33760 (Clearwater) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33760 (Clearwater) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33760 (Clearwater) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
